usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and APITemplate.io turns each “Order Paid” into a finished image through “Create Image”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create Image” in APITemplate.io
bestTemplate.why: Each paid order generates an image from one of your saved image templates.

watchOut: “Create Image” uses an existing image template, so build it in APITemplate.io before you turn the flow on.
